name: Laguna de los Témpanos at Vinciguerra Glacier
region: Andorra valley, Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego
why: A peat bog, a lenga forest and a rock slope lead to a grey lake with floating ice under the Vinciguerra glacier, 8 km from the centre of Ushuaia.
book: Free, no permit. Drive or take a taxi up the Andorra valley along Camino del Valle to its end, where a blue gate marks the start. The ice caves of the glacier only with a specialised guide.
water: Streams in the forest; the lake is glacier melt. Nothing to buy after the gate.
dangers: Deep mud and a wide peat bog: waterproof boots and gaiters.
The last climb is a steep rock slope, icy or snowy in spring and autumn.
Never walk on the glacier or into the ice caves without a guide.
turnaround: Not at the top of the forest by 13:00: turn back, the rock slope and the bog take the rest of the day.

points.name: Andorra valley gate
points.note: The blue gate at the end of Camino del Valle. A wide peat bog and the Arroyo Grande bridge come first.

points.name: Laguna Encantada fork
points.note: In the lenga forest about 1 km past the bridge: left for Laguna de los Témpanos, right for Laguna Encantada.

points.name: Laguna de los Témpanos
points.note: Above a steep rock slope: a grey lake with floating ice under the Vinciguerra glacier. Return the same way.
